description: Disposal of Scrap Metal of the Department of Sri Lanka Railways
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-12-10 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Bids have been invited following the National Competitive Bidding method to dispose the scrap metal available with the Department of Sri Lanka Railways. Accordingly, 11 bidders have submitted bids for the same. The proposal made by the Minister of Transport Highways and Urban Development to award the tender for the disposal of scrap metal to M/s. Melwire Rolling (Pvt) Ltd. for a sum of Rs. 721.257 million (inclusive of VAT) and to M/s. S R Steel (Pvt) Ltd. for a sum of Rs. 167.507 (inclusive of VAT), the bidders who have submitted substantially highest responsive offers, based on the recommendation of the Standing High Level Procurement Committee pertaining to the relevant bids, was approved by the Cabinet.
